title: Finite locally constant sheaves of modules: finite values iff finite stalks
statement: Let $Y$ be a scheme, $\Lambda$ a finite commutative ring and $\mathcal G$ a sheaf of $\Lambda_Y$-modules on the small etale site $Y_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves]. The following are equivalent: (1) there are an etale covering $\{U_i\to Y\}_{i\in I}$ and finite $\Lambda$-modules $M_i$ (finite as sets) such that $\mathcal G|_{U_i}\cong\underline{M_i}$, the constant sheaf of $\Lambda_{U_i}$-modules with value $M_i$, for every $i$ (Stacks 03RU: finite locally constant with finite values); (2) $\mathcal G$ is finite locally constant [def-constructible-finite-locally-constant] for the coefficient category of $\Lambda$-modules, i.e. locally constant [def-constructible-locally-constant] and every geometric stalk $\mathcal G_{\bar y}$ is a finite set [def-constructible-finite]; (3) $\mathcal G$ is locally constant and of finite type as a sheaf of $\Lambda_Y$-modules (Stacks 03RW(3): locally generated by finitely many sections). Moreover, in (1) the stalk of $\mathcal G$ at a geometric point $\bar y$ factoring through $U_i$ is isomorphic to $M_i$.

source.place: Definition 03RU (definition-finite-locally-constant), the forms for sets and for Lambda-modules; Definition 03RW (definition-constructible) part (3), 'of finite type and locally constant'; the equivalences are not stated in Stacks (agent-formulated).
